role: The int-array tag, type id 11: block-palette data, structure block lists, the UUID ints of entities saved as four ints.
scope_reason: Part of the NBT layer behind snapshots and digests.

members.name: intArray
members.note: Canonical text ia:1,2; empty is ia:.

members.name: write
members.note: Length int then one int per element.

members.name: func_152446_a
members.note: Reads the length, accounts 32 bytes per element to the size tracker, then one readInt per element.

members.name: toString
members.note: Java's text form: built only by ItemStack.func_151000_E (the item hover in a chat line), CommandGive (chat commands are not agent input) and logging. func_151000_E runs at StatList's init on tagless stacks (id, Count, Damage: a short and a byte) and in a death message only for an item with hasDisplayName (EntityDamageSource, EntityDamageSourceIndirect, CombatTracker), and only the anvil names an item (world.conf anvil = off)

notes: Java's write loops writeInt per element; native writes the same layout in write_payload's NBT_INT_ARRAY case.
